data.why: The repository bundles tests/pdbs/*.pdb structures that volumizer analyze is designed to process, including 4JPN (used throughout the README) plus synthetic cavity/pocket/pore examples; the gallery's own upload endpoint accepts these same file types.

goals: detect and classify occluded volumes (cavities, pockets, pores) in a protein structure of interest
browse an indexed set of previously analyzed structures and filter hits by volume type or size
inspect a specific hit's annotated volume interactively in a 3D Mol* viewer to judge its biological plausibility
upload a new PDB/CIF structure through the gallery UI and get its detected volumes added to the browsable index
compare the volume and dimensions of a pocket or pore across structures to prioritize candidates for ligand binding or solute filtering studies

review.summary: The tree matches the gallery's purpose and its five phases and seven features map closely onto the actual UI, and none of the ten screens I opened contradicts its node. Before filing it needs better evidence for three filter/sort tasks (t4, t5, t12), the README's resolution caveat on the re-run branch, and tasks for shape filtering and for finding the residues around a volume.
